name: agent-office
description: Agent Office: your session's agents as office staff who walk to the warehouse, archives or workshop as they work, plus a live dashboard of context, cost, permissions and subagents. Forked from Flightdeck by Stephen Casella

architectPattern.title: Architect pattern
architectPattern.description: Regular expression (case-insensitive) for the agent types and server tools that count as the on-call architect, e.g. advisor|architect|reviewer

architectLabel.title: Architect label
architectLabel.description: Name shown for the architect role

gateLabel.title: Gate label
gateLabel.description: Name shown for the permission panel

panels.title: Panels
panels.description: Comma-separated panels in display order: office, main, architect, gate, agents, loops, receipt, log. Leave one out to hide it.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Animate the connectors while real work flows, or keep them still

moments.title: Architect moments
moments.description: Show the inferred moment of each consult (before a plan, error repeats, before done)

matchDescriptions.title: Match agent descriptions
matchDescriptions.description: Also count an agent type as the architect when its description (not just its name) matches the pattern

maxCards.title: Cards before swimlanes
maxCards.description: Agent cards drawn side by side; more agents than this switch to swimlanes (1-6)

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: auto: a summary of at most 8 rows when the pane sits inline above the prompt, two columns from 110 columns when docked, one column otherwise

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: office is warm wood and lamplight for dark terminals; theme follows your Claude Code theme (light, dark, colour-blind); pastel is fixed colours tuned for dark terminals

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when a session starts

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show context, agents, consults and denials in the status line

costBudgetUsd.title: Session budget (USD)
costBudgetUsd.description: Toast when the session's cost passes these percentages of this budget; 0 turns cost alerts off

costWarnPct.title: Budget alert levels
costWarnPct.description: Comma-separated percentages of the budget that raise a toast

contextWarnPct.title: Context alert levels
contextWarnPct.description: Comma-separated context-fill percentages that raise a toast

routing.title: Supervisor
routing.description: auto: route each prompt to a light, standard or heavy model and effort when the switch pays for its re-cache; off: always the session's own model

heavyModel.title: Heavy model
heavyModel.description: Model for design, debugging, refactors and long briefs

lightEffort.title: Light effort
lightEffort.description: Effort for quick questions (models without effort ignore it)

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: Long-running sessions the supervisor hands tasks to, as Label=folder,folder: what it handles, separated by |. A folder is a project folder's name.
departments.default: PR Review=pr-reviews: reviewing pull requests | Sphere Dev=sphere-web,sphere-v3-web,sphere-iconic-web: coding tasks in the Sphere repos (send to the repo the task names) | Quilt Discussion=Quilt-Discussion: Quilt code and design discussion | Social=social-expert: Instagram and YouTube content | Daily Dose=daily-dose: tech questions and what's new in technology
